```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(backgammonr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

This notebook stays on roll `1-6` and adds three metric layers:

- MC-screening metrics from `bg_eval_reference_aware()`
- efficiency metrics from `bg_eval_efficiency()`
- calibration metrics from `bg_eval_calibration()`

```{r settings}
truth_budget <- 100000L
roll_1_6_truth_path <- file.path(
  "artifacts",
  "opening_truths",
  paste0("opening_1-6_truth_budget_", truth_budget, ".rds")
)

if (!file.exists(roll_1_6_truth_path)) {
  stop("Run 01_save_all_21_opening_truths.Rmd first so the 1-6 truth file exists.")
}

metric_budgets <- c(16L, 32L, 64L, 128L, 256L, 512L)
metric_seeds <- 1:25
metric_methods <- c("thompson", "top_two_thompson", "ucb", "equal")
metric_overwrite <- FALSE

study_dir <- file.path("artifacts", "studies")
dir.create(study_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

metric_path <- file.path(
  study_dir,
  "opening_1-6_mc_screening_efficiency_calibration.rds"
)

truth_1_6 <- bg_truth_load(roll_1_6_truth_path)

problem_1_6 <- bg_problem(
  state = bg_initial_board(),
  roll = bg_roll(1L, 6L),
  simulation_policy = "random",
  reward_model = "scalar_payoff",
  posterior_model = "beta_pseudo",
  problem_id = "opening_1-6"
)
```

```{r comparison-run}
metric_compare_1_6 <- bg_compare_algorithms(
  problems = problem_1_6,
  methods = metric_methods,
  budgets = metric_budgets,
  seeds = metric_seeds,
  proxy_references = truth_1_6$reference,
  save_path = metric_path,
  overwrite = metric_overwrite
)
```

```{r mc-screening}
screening_eval <- bg_eval_reference_aware(
  metric_compare_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  top_k = 3L
)

screening_summary <- aggregate(
  screening_eval[, c(
    "top1_match",
    "simple_regret",
    "share_mc_screened_suboptimal",
    "mc_not_separated_from_best_set_size",
    "chosen_mc_not_separated_from_best"
  )],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = screening_eval$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = screening_eval$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

screening_summary <- screening_summary[
  order(screening_summary$allocation_policy, screening_summary$checkpoint),
]

knitr::kable(
  screening_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "MC-screening and regret summaries by method and budget."
)
```

```{r efficiency}
efficiency_eval <- bg_eval_efficiency(
  metric_compare_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  epsilon = 0.01
)

efficiency_summary <- aggregate(
  efficiency_eval[, c(
    "first_budget_top1_match",
    "first_budget_epsilon_optimal",
    "first_runtime_top1_match",
    "first_runtime_epsilon_optimal",
    "auc_top1_match",
    "auc_simple_regret",
    "mean_brier_top1"
  )],
  by = list(allocation_policy = efficiency_eval$allocation_policy),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  efficiency_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average efficiency summaries across repeated seeds."
)
```

```{r calibration}
calibration_eval <- bg_eval_calibration(
  metric_compare_1_6,
  truth = truth_1_6$reference,
  bins = 5L
)

calibration_brier <- aggregate(
  calibration_eval$raw[, "brier_top1", drop = FALSE],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = calibration_eval$raw$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = calibration_eval$raw$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

calibration_final <- calibration_eval$summary[
  calibration_eval$summary$checkpoint == max(metric_budgets) &
    calibration_eval$summary$n > 0L,
]

ece_summary <- aggregate(
  calibration_final[, "ece_component", drop = FALSE],
  by = list(allocation_policy = calibration_final$allocation_policy),
  FUN = sum,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  calibration_brier,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Average Brier score for `recommended_prob_best` by method and budget."
)

knitr::kable(
  ece_summary,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Expected calibration error at the largest budget."
)
```

```{r solve-rates}
solve_rates <- aggregate(
  screening_eval[, c("top1_match", "epsilon_optimal")],
  by = list(
    allocation_policy = screening_eval$allocation_policy,
    checkpoint = screening_eval$checkpoint
  ),
  FUN = mean,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

knitr::kable(
  solve_rates,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Solve rates by method and budget."
)
```

```{r mc-screening-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  screening_summary,
  aes(x = checkpoint, y = chosen_mc_not_separated_from_best, color = allocation_policy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Rate of choosing a move inside the MC non-separated best set",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Chosen move in MC non-separated set",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r solve-rate-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  solve_rates,
  aes(x = checkpoint, y = top1_match, color = allocation_policy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Top-1 solve rate over budget",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Solve rate",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r efficiency-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  efficiency_eval,
  aes(x = allocation_policy, y = first_budget_top1_match, color = allocation_policy)
) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.65, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "First budget that finds the truth-best move",
    x = "Method",
    y = "First budget with top-1 match",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r brier-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  calibration_brier,
  aes(x = checkpoint, y = brier_top1, color = allocation_policy)
) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Brier score for `recommended_prob_best`",
    x = "Budget checkpoint",
    y = "Mean Brier score",
    color = "Method"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```

```{r reliability-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ggplot(
  calibration_final,
  aes(
    x = mean_predicted_prob_best,
    y = observed_top1_rate,
    color = allocation_policy
  )
) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Reliability curve at the largest budget",
    x = "Mean predicted probability best",
    y = "Observed top-1 match rate",
    color = "Method",
    size = "Count"
  ) +
  xlim(0, 1) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
